```{r}
# get nest numbers from the current data:
nestnums <- nData %>% select(nest) %>% unlist
nests <- data.frame(nest=nData$nest)

# and whatever column from the old data:
filename <- paste0(homeDir, "nest_data/nest_data_cleaned_0227_1740_.csv")
nData_feb <- read_csv(filename)
nData_feb <- ff(nData_feb) %>% # add field_fate column
  group_by(nest) %>%
  summarize(field_fate = last(field_fate))
nData_feb <- nData_feb %>% filter(nest %in% nestnums)
nData_feb_2 <- merge(x=nests, y=nData_feb, by="nest", all=TRUE)
write.csv(nData_feb_2, "nests_feb_field_fate.csv")
```

#### add field fate function
```{r include=FALSE}
ff <- function(nData){
    cat("*** adding field fate category ***\n")
  cat("old final_fate category:\n")
  print(table(nData$final_fate))
  nData <- nData %>%
    mutate(field_fate = final_fate) %>%
    mutate(final_fate = coalesce(cam_fate, field_fate )) 
  cat("new final_fate category:\n")
  print(table(nData$final_fate))
  cat("new field_fate category:\n")
  print(table(nData$field_fate))
  
  nData$fdate <- nData$k
  return(nData)
}
```

### More tables:

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# fail <- c("S","F","Hu","D","A")
fail <- c(0,2:6)
corr_fate <- ndGLM_ %>% 
  # filter(HF_mis==1) %>%
  filter(misclass==1) %>%
  mutate(
    correction = case_when(
      fate == 7 & cfate %in% fail ~ "U to F",
      fate == 7 & cfate == 1 ~ "U to H",
      fate == 1 & cfate %in% fail ~ "H to F",
      fate %in% fail & cfate == 1 ~ "F to H",
      fate %in% fail & fate != cfate ~ "cause of fail"
    )) %>% select(nest, species, field_fate, cam_fate, correction)

cat("nests marked unknown that actually failed:\n", 
    corr_fate$nest[corr_fate$correction=="U to F"])
cat("\n\nnests marked unknown that actually hatched:\n",
    corr_fate$nest[corr_fate$correction=="U to H"])
cat("\n\nnests marked failed that actually hatched:\n",
    corr_fate$nest[corr_fate$correction=="F to H"])
cat("\n\nnests marked hatched that actually failed:\n",
    corr_fate$nest[corr_fate$correction=="H to F"])
```

I made this one a function in the nestGLM package:

```{r}
datName <- "ndGLM1" # complete data, no rows removed yet
  ndDiag <- get(datName)
  expl = prVars
  dep = "is_u"
  # creeate an index of variables with at least one NA:
  exp_index <- lapply(expl, function(x) sum(is.na(ndDiag[x]))) > 0
  exp_miss <- expl[exp_index] 
  exp_miss
  # ndDiag <- datDiag %>%
  #   dplyr::mutate(missAge = is.na(nest_age), # is this part necessary?
  #          missFate = is.na(cam_fate),
  #          missInt = is.na(obs_int),
  #          missDate = is.na(fdate))
  # dep <- "is_u"
  # expl <- c("nest_age", "cam_fate", "species", "obs_int", "fdate")

  # missPl <- ndDiag %>% finalfit::missing_pairs(dependent=dep, explanatory=expl)
  # ggsave("missing_data.png", plot=missPl)
  tabNames <- list()
  for(v in seq_along(exp_miss)){
    # v=1
    # expl[v]
    # expl[-v]
    missTab <- ndDiag %>%
      dplyr::mutate(across(c(species, cam_fate), as.factor)) %>%
      finalfit::missing_compare(dependent = expl[v], # this should be the table
      # finalfit::missing_pairs(dependent = expl[v],  # this is the plot
                                # explanatory = expl[expl!=v])
                                explanatory = expl[-v])
    print(missTab)
    titl <- names(missTab)[1]
    names(missTab) <- c("var", "val", "not_missing", "missing", "p")
    missTabFancy <- missTab %>%
      gt::gt(rowname_col = "var") %>%
      gt::tab_header(title=titl) %>%
      gt::cols_label(val ~ "",
                 not_missing ~ "Not missing (percent)",
                 missing ~ "Missing (percent)",
                 p ~ "p-value") %>%
      nestGLM::save_tab(suffix=paste(dName,dep,expl[v],sep="_"), rtf=TRUE)
    tabNames[v] <- missTab
  }
```

#### Create and save the AIC table

```{r q2-aic, echo=FALSE}
# fname <- mods %>% bic_mod() %>% save_tab()
# suffix = paste0("_unscl_cc_q2_", nfate, "_fates")
# suffix = paste0("-",datName,"-q2-", nfate, "fates")
suffix = paste0("-",datName,"-q2-", uVar,fVar)
# suffix = "_scl_cc_q1"

aicTab <- unname(mods) %>% aic_mod()
fname <- aicTab %>% save_tab(suffix=suffix, rtf=TRUE)
cat("creating AIC table; filename =",fname)

knitr::include_graphics(paste0("analysis/",fname),
                        dpi=(1300/6)) # dpi setting = only thing that works

```

#### Create and save the regression table for the best model

```{r q2-regtab, echo=TRUE}
# first, find the number of the best model
# modnum = 13# manually enter number for top model
# get all the model names:
modNames <- as.list(modnames(mods)) # list of models in the order they were specified
# c <- confset(cand.set=mods, modnames=modNames, method='raw')
# 
# while(aWeight < 0.95){
#   
#
topMod = aicTab$`_data`$`__GT_ROWNAME_PRIVATE__`[1]
cat("top model:", topMod)
secTopMod = aicTab$`_data`$`__GT_ROWNAME_PRIVATE__`[2]
cat("second best model:", secTopMod)
cat("delta AIC of second best model:", aicTab$`_data`$dAICc[2])
modnum = which(modNames == topMod)
modnum2 = which(modNames == secTopMod)
cat("creating regression table for top model, model number", modnum, "; model formula:", paste(mods[[modnum]]$formula) )

regrTab <- tabRegr(modNum=modnum,
                   mods=mods,
                   resp=resp,
                   debug=T,
                   # suffix =paste0("q2_",nfate,"fates"))
                   suffix =paste0(datName,"q2_",uVar,fVar))
knitr::include_graphics(paste0("analysis/",regrTab), 
                        dpi=(1300/6)) # dpi setting = only thing that works
# confSet <- length(which(cumsum(aicTab$`_data`$weight)<0.95))
# confSet <- which(cumsum(aicTab$`_data`$weight)<0.95) # this doesn't get the last one unless it sums to exactly 0.95
```
